prompts.prompt: Create one finished wide landscape 16:9 game environment concept image, variant 1 of a survivor BASE in a postapocalyptic northern Russian dacha district. The attached image is a STYLE AND CAMERA REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its exact oblique isometric three-quarter overhead camera inclination, orthographic game perspective, house/human scale, exceptionally dense realistic hand-crafted pixel-art texture detail, rich green/olive/golden foliage, natural warm directional sunlight and deep grounded contact shadows. No HUD, no UI, no text, no collage. New composition: an inhabited repaired dacha compound in birch and conifer forest, organic irregular perimeter of wooden fences and salvaged sheet metal, a sturdy repaired central timber cottage, workshop with open shed, small infirmary cottage, patched glass greenhouse, vegetable beds, covered supplies store, watch platform at a gated muddy entrance, modest radio antenna, generator under a lean-to, water barrels and communal cooking fire. Show around 5 tiny survivors doing chores, correctly scaled. Narrow winding muddy paths and wheel ruts with small puddles connect buildings; every other area densely filled with lush varied weeds, flowers, bushes, fruit trees, climbing vines, practical scattered props: firewood, ladders, crates, tools, pallets, buckets, tarps, wheelbarrow, rusted repair truck, clothesline. Base feels lived-in, resourceful and plausible, sheltered and functional with weathered repairs. As much nuanced environmental density as reference, saturated yet natural colors, sharp readable structures, coherent object-specific shadows. Avoid empty flat lawns, repetitive tile patterns, toy-like clean 3D, giant people, exaggerated fantasy fortifications, overhead flat map, cinematic low-angle, blur, tilt-shift. Single cohesive scene, no cutaway.

Generate ONE finished wide landscape 16:9 concept image, variant 2: an inhabited survivor BASE built inside an abandoned northern Russian FORESTRY DEPOT / SAWMILL. Attached image is reference for ART STYLE AND CAMERA ONLY. Reproduce its exact oblique orthographic three-quarter overhead isometric game camera inclination, moderate elevated view, realistic exquisitely detailed pixel-art environment, saturated natural green/olive/golden vegetation, warm directional daylight, deep coherent contact shadows; no HUD, UI, title, collage or map labels. Original layout: repaired broad timber sawmill barn with rusty corrugated roof and open workshop bay, smaller brick generator building with patched windows, two weathered wooden dormitory cabins, tiny clinic with a medical symbol, improvised covered communal kitchen, repaired greenhouse beside raised beds, lumber drying racks and neatly stacked logs. Irregular perimeter of timber fence reinforced by salvaged sheet metal, sturdy entrance and small timber guard platform. A rusted forestry truck being repaired in the yard, tractor under lean-to, radio mast, elevated rainwater tank, storage crates and fuel barrels. 5 small human survivors doing chores at believable scale. Dense surrounding birch and conifer woodland and shrubs; narrow muddy work paths connect facilities, weeds and flowering grass creep around every building and fence. Include rich microdetail: sawdust, split logs, tools on benches, coiled cables, ladders, pallets, roof patches, ropes, wheelbarrow, tarps, buckets, puddles and tire ruts. Ground visually varied and grounded; useful little work areas, not a giant empty square. Readable functional survivor base, rustic resourcefulness, same detailed mature game-art treatment as reference. Avoid pristine modern buildings, sterile terrain, low detail, toy-like 3D, flat overhead map, cinematic horizon or low camera, depth of field, giant characters, science fiction. Full-frame cohesive scene.

ONE wide landscape 16:9 game environment concept image, variant 3: a small inhabited survivor BASE beside a forest river in a northern Russian rural postapocalypse. Use attached image as CAMERA AND VISUAL STYLE reference only. Match exactly the moderately elevated oblique orthographic three-quarter isometric camera angle, apparent scale of houses/people, dense exquisite realistic pixel-art detailing, saturated lush natural green/olive/golden vegetation, directional warm daylight and solid contact shadows. No UI, no HUD, no text, no collage, no divided panels. Original coherent playable layout: repaired timber riverside house with a covered porch, adjacent communal shed and workshop, two little survivor cabins, modest infirmary cottage, glass greenhouse and fertile raised vegetable plots. A narrow river winds along the right edge with reeds, believable reflections, small timber dock, two tied worn fishing boats and a water filtration pump. Gravel-and-mud footpaths loop between shelters. An improvised timber-and-salvaged-metal perimeter follows the land; guarded gate bottom left, small lookout, radio antenna beside house, generator shed, rainwater tanks, pantry under tarps, camp kitchen with small cooking fire and benches. 5 appropriately small survivors gardening, fishing, repairing. Dense birches, conifers, apple trees, brambles, wildflowers, weeds and vines fill remaining areas, leave practical circulation paths readable. Include many grounded microprops: firewood, ladder, crates, fish nets drying, buckets, wheelbarrow, spare boards, hand tools, barrels, clothesline, abandoned utility van now supplies store, muddy ruts and puddles. Buildings weathered but locally patched and useful, convincing quiet survivor refuge. Equal detail across full frame, sharp layered foliage and nuanced material textures. Avoid empty lawns, sterile terrain, flat overhead map, horizon line, low camera, giant people, toy 3D, shallow depth of field, sci-fi architecture, cinematic blur. Riverbank should be natural rather than a decorative moat.
